notes.title: We have a release date! 8th March, 5 pm UTC
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26893398/c6f23c98e50c27090c22bd4a2f09197ea711be83.jpg

We are proud to announce our release date:
mark the 8th of MARCH 2017, 5 PM UTC red in your calendar (or easier, put Subsiege on your Steam wishlist)!

As an early bird you can save 35% on the prize of Subsiege, so don't be late ;)

We are always up for an AMA or feedback, so don't hasitate to write us!

As press member you can reach us at press@subsiege-game.com
